name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # Groups AccordionItems. Single-open by default: every item shares the same
  # <details name>, so the browser closes the others when one opens.
  class Accordion < Base
    def initialize(multiple: false, disabled: false, **attrs)
      @multiple = multiple
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_accordion]
      context[:ruby_ui_accordion] = {
        name: (@multiple ? nil : "ruby-ui-accordion-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"),
        disabled: @disabled
      }
      div(**attrs, &)
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_accordion] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "accordion"},
        class: "flex w-full flex-col"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The panel of an AccordionItem. Attributes and classes go to the inner
  # element, like shadcn's AccordionContent.
  class AccordionContent < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(data: {slot: "accordion-content"}, class: "text-sm") do
        div(**attrs, &)
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "pt-0 pb-4 [&_a]:underline [&_a]:underline-offset-3 [&_a]:hover:text-foreground [&_p:not(:last-child)]:mb-4"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Chevron down while closed, chevron up while open (lucide icons, swapped
  # with CSS on the parent <details open>). Pass a block to render your own.
  class AccordionIcon < Base
    CHEVRONS = {down: "m6 9 6 6 6-6", up: "m18 15-6-6-6 6"}.freeze

    def view_template(&block)
      if block
        span(**attrs, &block)
      else
        chevron(:down, "group-open/accordion-item:hidden")
        chevron(:up, "hidden group-open/accordion-item:inline")
      end
    end

    private

    def chevron(direction, visibility)
      svg(
        **mix(attrs, class: visibility),
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round"
      ) { |s| s.path(d: CHEVRONS[direction]) }
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: "accordion-trigger-icon"},
        class: "pointer-events-none ml-auto size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A native <details>. Open/close, the single-open group (name) and
  # find-in-page come from the browser; the height animates on
  # ::details-content where supported.
  class AccordionItem < Base
    def initialize(open: false, disabled: nil, **attrs)
      @open = open
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      group = context[:ruby_ui_accordion] || {}
      disabled = @disabled.nil? ? group[:disabled] : @disabled
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_accordion_item]
      context[:ruby_ui_accordion_item] = {disabled: disabled}

      item_attrs = attrs.dup
      item_attrs[:name] ||= group[:name] if group[:name]
      item_attrs[:open] = true if @open
      details(**item_attrs, &)
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_accordion_item] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "accordion-item"},
        class: [
          "group/accordion-item not-last:border-b [interpolate-size:allow-keywords]",
          "details-content:h-0 details-content:overflow-hidden open:details-content:h-auto",
          "details-content:transition-[height,content-visibility] details-content:transition-discrete",
          "details-content:duration-200 details-content:ease-out"
        ].join(" ")
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The <summary> of an AccordionItem. Wraps its content in a heading
  # (h3 by default) and appends the chevron (icon: false to render your own).
  class AccordionTrigger < Base
    LEVELS = (1..6)

    def initialize(level: 3, icon: true, **attrs)
      raise ArgumentError, "level must be 1..6, got #{level.inspect}" unless level.is_a?(Integer) && LEVELS.cover?(level)

      @level = level
      @icon = icon
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      item = context[:ruby_ui_accordion_item] || {}
      trigger_attrs = item[:disabled] ? mix(attrs, aria: {disabled: "true"}, tabindex: "-1") : attrs

      summary(**trigger_attrs) do
        send(:"h#{@level}", &block)
        render AccordionIcon.new if @icon
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "accordion-trigger"},
        class: [
          "group/accordion-trigger relative flex flex-1 cursor-pointer list-none items-start justify-between",
          "rounded-md border border-transparent py-4 text-left text-sm font-medium transition-all outline-none",
          "hover:underline focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
          "aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden"
        ].join(" ")
      }
    end
  end
end
